notes: Dated the colored Braun and Hogenberg plate to vol. 5 (1598) though Commons says 1592; #1 and #2 are later uncolored printings of the same plate, #3 a Venetian copy. Skipped #10 (Ducros watercolor of the harbor, 1778): a long strip dominated by foreground lava rocks. Skipped #11 (Püttner, dated only “before 1881”) and #13 (1866, low resolution). #18/#19 (2011 aerials with Etna) have an airplane wing in frame.
